name: biph
description: 本地自托管篮球记分牌 —— Docker 一条命令部署,局域网内运行,计时器不依赖网络

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @biph/server && npm run test -w @biph/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @biph/shared && npm run typecheck -w @biph/server && npm run typecheck -w @biph/client
